daily_lessons.source: Internal scenario benchmark: l0-audit/econ.py profiles (1, 3, 6, 10 lessons/active day); PLAN 1.3 estimates 3–5 weeks for ordinary course completion. Not measured.

d1_retention.source: Adjust global D1 26%, iOS 27%; upper stress case spans PLAN B0 Day 2 target 40%. https://www.adjust.com/resources/guides/user-retention/

d7_retention.source: Adjust global D7 13%; range spans PLAN B0 Day 7 target 20% (one-day offset in Sharky). https://www.adjust.com/glossary/retention-rate/

d30_retention.source: Adjust global D30 7%, regional 4–6%, iOS 8%; upper stress case is not a measured Sharky rate. https://www.adjust.com/resources/guides/user-retention/

practice_repeat_day.source: Internal stress window: PLAN 1.3 course duration 3–5 weeks, with an early week-one repeat case. No published Sharky novelty benchmark; repeat day must be observed.

trial_to_paid.source: RevenueCat 2026 trial-duration medians roughly 25–43%; wider rounded stress range. https://www.revenuecat.com/state-of-subscription-apps/

monthly_price_usd.source: RevenueCat 2026 gaming monthly median around $5, education around $10; $15 upper stress price, not a recommendation. https://www.revenuecat.com/state-of-subscription-apps/

monthly_churn.source: RevenueCat 2026 six-month monthly subscription retention medians 14–26%; equivalent constant monthly churn about 20–30%, wider stress range. Early renewal churn differs in reality. https://www.revenuecat.com/state-of-subscription-apps/

offer_to_trial.source: RevenueCat 2026 install-to-trial medians 4.4–8.9% across prices; conditional late-offer rate unknown. Broad sensitivity scenarios, not an equivalent benchmark. https://www.revenuecat.com/state-of-subscription-apps/

trial_days.source: RevenueCat 2026 trial duration buckets; seven-day trials common in education. https://www.revenuecat.com/state-of-subscription-apps/

bankroll_pace_fraction.source: Internal PLAN 1.3 and l0-audit/econ.py soft slowdown/refill variants; broad pace stress levels, not an observed currency or pacing benchmark.

persistent_activity_fraction.source: Structural sensitivity: exact-day Adjust retention benchmarks do not establish cross-day correlation. Quarter/half/three-quarter persistent cohort bracket; replace with longitudinal beta observations if available.

post_d30_half_life_days.source: Structural sensitivity: Adjust D30 benchmark ends at day 30; one/three/six-month decay scenarios for finite course plus continuing practice, not measured long-term app activity.

wall_offer_to_paid.source: RevenueCat 2026 D35 install-to-paid medians 2.1% freemium, 10.7% hard wall; contextual only, NOT conditional offer conversion. Broad eligible-user sensitivity range, no Sharky WTP data. https://www.revenuecat.com/state-of-subscription-apps/ Separate wall offer parameter; same starting bracket avoids assuming a winner.

bankroll_offer_to_paid.source: RevenueCat 2026 D35 install-to-paid medians 2.1% freemium, 10.7% hard wall; contextual only, NOT conditional offer conversion. Broad eligible-user sensitivity range, no Sharky WTP data. https://www.revenuecat.com/state-of-subscription-apps/ Separate bankroll offer parameter; same starting bracket avoids assuming a winner.

practice_offer_to_paid.source: RevenueCat 2026 D35 install-to-paid medians 2.1% freemium, 10.7% hard wall; contextual only, NOT conditional offer conversion. Broad eligible-user sensitivity range, no Sharky WTP data. https://www.revenuecat.com/state-of-subscription-apps/ Separate practice offer parameter; same starting bracket avoids assuming a winner.

practice_participation.source: Internal structural sensitivity: PLAN B0 targets and Beta activity practice steps enable observed participation; no published Sharky range. Quarter/half/three-quarter eligible active users scenarios, not a measured rate.
